name: Francis inward-flow water turbine
description: Francis developed and built a full-scale inward-flow turbine after acquiring rights to Howd’s design.

impact.note: A much more efficient turbine built on Howd's design; it became the most common hydropower turbine worldwide and founded a line of mixed-flow machines.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: A county historical survey reports that Francis purchased Howd patent rights in 1847.

evidence.supports: County historical survey dates Samuel Howd’s inward-flow patent to 1838 and reports Francis purchased rights in 1847 and built a full-scale inward-flow turbine in 1849. It cites Lewis et al. for these historical statements.

events.caveats: The survey is a retrospective account and cites earlier historical research.
